title: WCS page: Set WCS from features cannot pick each feature correctly; use four pick buttons in a small table

labels.name: claimed

labels.name: source:agent

body:
The maintainer reported this in chat (2026-11-18), in his own words:

> bug, when on wcs page, using the set wcs from feature.. u cannot pich each feature correctly.. From a useability feature.. there should be four pick buttons, one for each, z,x,y,origin..  so we dont have to use a dropdown.. it should be clearly a small "table" for it, and then a apply/clear button under the four selections.

## What happens

On the WCS page, the "Set WCS from features" block picks one role at a time through a dropdown. The user cannot pick each feature correctly. The report does not say which pick fails. The worker finds out (see the first steps).

## Wanted

1. A small table with four rows, one for each role: Origin, X axis, Y axis, Z axis.
2. Each row has its own pick button. No dropdown chooses the role. The row shows what is picked (a plain-English name of the feature, not an internal id; see #2403) or "not set".
3. A pick button starts a pick for its own role. A click in the viewport fills that row only. A second pick for the same row replaces it. A row can be cleared alone.
4. Under the table: one "Apply" button and one "Clear" button. "Apply" is enabled only when the picks are enough to define a WCS (for example, an origin, or the axis picks that the existing rules accept). Say in a tooltip what is missing when it is disabled. "Clear" empties all four rows.
5. Apply is one undoable command (the WCS from the setup stays the single source: `setup::wcs_slot`, no second derivation). A conflict between picks (for example X parallel to Z) is refused with a plain message at Apply, not accepted.
6. The page keeps its layout test and its pick tests. UI text is plain English.

## First steps for the worker

1. Reproduce the pick failure. Read `crates/ui/src/egui_app/wcs_pick_row.rs`, `setup_settings_page.rs` and the tests `wcs_page_picks.rs` and `wcs_pick_tests.rs`. Find which pick goes to the wrong role or is dropped (for example a face, an edge, a vertex or a circle centre; see #701, #739, #1562).
2. Fix that defect with a pinning test, in the same PR as the new table or in a first commit.
3. Build the four-row table. Keep each file under about 400 lines.

## Constraints

- AGENTS.md "Everything Is a Command": a pick is ephemeral UI state until Apply. Apply and Clear that changes the setup go through the undoable command. The MCP tool for set WCS from feature picks exists (#937). It stays and uses the same command.
- A UI PR needs before and after screenshots in the PR body. Tests assert labels, roles, enabled state and commands, not pixel values. Update `layout_page_wcs` if it exists.
- Do not use the `fig8.camproj` or `testpart.sc` user files in any test or screenshot.

## Done means

- A test shows that each of the four pick buttons fills its own row, for each feature kind that the page accepts.
- A test shows that Apply writes the expected WCS, that undo restores it, and that a conflicting set is refused.
- A test shows that Clear empties the four rows.
- The PR has the before and after screenshots.
